core.errors.blocked.meaning: ModDB has blocked this IP for a while (usually 1 hour).
core.errors.blocked.hint: Provodnik waits and retries on its own. If it doesn't clear up, stop, wait an hour and run it again: whatever already downloaded is kept.
core.errors.dlcli.meaning: GAMMA's stalker-gamma-dl-cli couldn't get the link (it's outdated: ModDB now requires a browser).
core.errors.dlcli.hint: Provodnik uses the built-in browser (WebView2) instead; if you see this, the WebView2 Runtime isn't installed.
core.errors.cloudflare.hint: Wait a few minutes and try again; if it keeps happening, lower the ModDB downloads in Settings (1 or 2).
core.errors.tooMany.meaning: Too many requests to the server in a row.
core.errors.tooMany.hint: Lower the simultaneous downloads in Settings and try again in a little while.
core.errors.dns.hint: Check your internet. If everything else works, switch your DNS to 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8.
core.errors.connect.hint: Check your internet, VPN and firewall. The server may also be down: try again later.
core.errors.timeout.meaning: The connection stalled for too long.
core.errors.timeout.hint: Slow or unstable internet. It already retries on its own; if it keeps happening, run it again later.
core.errors.dropped.meaning: The connection dropped in the middle of the download.
core.errors.dropped.hint: Normal on unstable internet: the next attempt picks up where it left off.
core.errors.tls.meaning: The secure connection (TLS) to the server failed.
core.errors.tls.hint: Check the Windows date and time, and whether an antivirus is inspecting HTTPS traffic.
core.errors.notFound.meaning: The file no longer exists on the server.
core.errors.notFound.hint: The link in the GAMMA list is broken. Wait for the fix (it's usually quick) and update.
core.errors.server.hint: It's not on your end: try again in a few minutes.
core.errors.md5.meaning: The downloaded file isn't the one the GAMMA list expects.
core.errors.md5.hint: It re-downloads on its own. If it comes out the same twice, the author updated it on ModDB and it's accepted with a warning.
core.errors.corrupt.meaning: The archive is corrupted or incomplete.
core.errors.corrupt.hint: Delete it from downloads\ (or use Reinstall on the Mods screen) and it gets downloaded again.
core.errors.locked.meaning: Some program is holding on to the file.
core.errors.locked.hint: Close MO2, the game and any Explorer windows open in the GAMMA folder. An antivirus scan can also lock it: try again.
core.errors.denied.meaning: No permission to write to the folder.
core.errors.denied.hint: Close MO2 and the game. If GAMMA is in Program Files or another protected folder, reopen Provodnik as administrator (or move GAMMA to C:\GAMMA).
core.errors.disk.hint: Free up space: a fresh install needs about 150 GB. You can delete old files from downloads\ after installing.
core.errors.longPath.meaning: File path too long for Windows.
core.errors.longPath.hint: Enable long paths (the pre-install check has a button for it) or move GAMMA to a short folder like C:\GAMMA.
core.errors.noLink.meaning: ModDB didn't hand over the download link.
core.errors.noLink.hint: The addon may have been taken down or ModDB changed the page. Try again; if it persists, report it on the GAMMA Discord.
core.errors.missingFile.meaning: A file that should be there is missing.
core.errors.missingFile.hint: Your antivirus may have deleted one of GAMMA's tools (curl, 7z, stalker-gamma-dl-cli). Restore it from quarantine or download the GAMMA installer again.
core.errors.antivirus.hint: Add the GAMMA folder to your antivirus exclusions and try again.
core.errors.git.meaning: The git repository got locked up or broken.
core.errors.git.hint: Run it again: if it keeps happening, delete the repository folder in resources\ and it gets cloned from scratch.
core.bootstrap.notRooted: Choose a full folder path, with the drive letter (D:\Games).
core.bootstrap.sameDrive: GAMMA and Anomaly must be on the same drive.
core.bootstrap.nested: GAMMA and Anomaly must be separate folders, neither inside the other.
core.bootstrap.driveRoot: Use a folder, not the root of the drive.
core.bootstrap.forbidden: Keep out of {0}: the GAMMA wiki rules out the user folder (Documents, Desktop, OneDrive) and Program Files.
core.bootstrap.removable: USB sticks and external drives won't do: choose an internal drive.
core.bootstrap.network: Network folders won't do: choose a drive in this computer.
core.bootstrap.noDrive: That drive doesn't exist or isn't ready.
core.bootstrap.space: Only {0} free; at least {1} is needed.
core.bootstrap.spaceTight: {0} free: it fits, but the wiki recommends about 200 GB for headroom.
core.bootstrap.nonAscii: The path has accents or non-Latin letters, which the game often trips on. Prefer a plain name.
core.bootstrap.anomalyFound: There's already a complete Anomaly in the folder: it will be reused, not downloaded again.
core.bootstrap.anomalyNotEmpty: The Anomaly folder already has files: Anomaly will be extracted over them.
core.bootstrap.gammaFound: GAMMA RC3 is already extracted in the folder: only the rest is left.
core.bootstrap.gammaNotEmpty: The GAMMA folder already has files: RC3 will be extracted over them.
